output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function does not check overflows in the 'msg.sender' balances, allowing a large user balance and a large 'msg.value' in ether (from fundsWallet balance) can cause an integer overflow and set balances of a target user to '2^256 - 1' (maximum value representable by uint256).

The 'transferFrom' function does not check overflows in balances of 'msg.sender' and 'msg.sender' allowed amounts, allowing a large 'msg.value' in ether (from fundsWallet balance) and a large transfer amount can cause an integer overflow and set balances of target users to '2^256 - 1' (maximum value representable by uint256).
The 'receiveApproval' function is payable, allowing any external contract calling it to send ether to it, leading to potential unauthorized financial exposure.
